entries.title: Linear Gram row partition
entries.candidate: Smaller row chunks in the existing partial-Gram grid
entries.hypothesis: More independent threadgroups for narrow Grams, at the cost of scratch and final-fold work
entries.quality_gates: Coefficients, heldout R2/logloss, rank, class covariance and ill-conditioned inputs
entries.actual_implementation: Halve both existing Gram row partitions: 8192 to 4096 and 2048 to 1024. Existing tile-pair selection is unchanged. Workspace sizing and both Gram entry points consume the same chunk calculation.

entries.title: Linear sufficient-statistic reduction
entries.candidate: Striped or pairwise chunk-partial reduction
entries.hypothesis: Reduce dependent accumulation latency while retaining centered statistics
entries.quality_gates: Large offsets, nearly constant columns, sample weights and multiple targets
entries.actual_implementation: Fold chunk means, Gram entries and X-transpose-Y entries with four FP32 striped accumulators and a fixed pairwise finish instead of one dependent serial accumulator.

entries.title: ElasticNetCV device work granularity
entries.candidate: Alternative row work grouping for the same alpha/fold path
entries.hypothesis: Improve occupancy without changing regularization search or stopping tolerance
entries.quality_gates: Selected alpha, dual gap, coefficients, heldout RMSE and fold isolation
entries.actual_implementation: Predict two held-out rows per thread at a time, reusing every path coefficient across the two complete ascending feature chains. Preserve the existing MSE block fold and every alpha/fold.

entries.title: Huber gradient/loss work grouping
entries.baseline: Current gradient and loss row chunks
entries.candidate: Smaller bounded partial chunks or fused existing output work
entries.hypothesis: Shorten long serial chains and reduce repeated row traffic
entries.quality_gates: Robust objective, outlier behavior, convergence and heldout RMSE
entries.actual_implementation: Use 256-row loss/gradient partials in the resident Huber solver instead of its default 512-row partials; scratch and witness launch counts follow the existing HF_FOLD-derived helpers.

entries.title: Multiclass logistic gradient schedule
entries.candidate: Alternative row/chunk geometry for the same FP32 product
entries.hypothesis: Balance output parallelism against repeated residual reads
entries.quality_gates: Heldout logloss and accuracy, optimizer status, extreme logits and class imbalance
entries.actual_implementation: Use nominal 1024-row chunks and at most 512 gradient partials instead of 2048 rows and 256 partials. Workspace and launch planning share the new constants.

entries.title: SMO gradient row reuse
entries.estimators: SVC, SVR and OneClassSVM where caller applies
entries.candidate: Reuse feature loads or independent row work within the fused update
entries.hypothesis: Reduce repeated kernel-vector memory work without reducing working set or iteration budget
entries.quality_gates: Margin, support-vector state, regression residual, anomaly ranking and refusal semantics
entries.actual_implementation: Increase moved-row shared staging from 3072 to 4096 FP32 feature words. Kernel-row and alpha updates retain their complete ascending order.

entries.title: PCA covariance work granularity
entries.candidate: Alternative bounded centered-covariance chunks
entries.hypothesis: Increase parallelism while retaining the numerically safer centered formulation
entries.quality_gates: Explained variance, reconstruction, orthogonality and small singular directions
entries.actual_implementation: Partition the existing compensated centered covariance into nominal 2048-row partials, then compensate the partial fold and divide once by n-1. Means and input restoration contract are retained.

entries.title: Decomposition tiled product geometry
entries.estimators: NMF, FactorAnalysis, PLS, ALS, SVD and least squares callers
entries.candidate: Alternative slab depth or microtile on the same product route
entries.hypothesis: Trade shared-memory reuse against occupancy; preserve transpose and tail handling
entries.quality_gates: Factor/solve residuals plus every affected estimator task metric; no standalone GEMM admission
entries.actual_implementation: Increase the tiled product's K slab depth from 16 to 32, retaining the 32x32 output tile, 2x2 thread microtile, transpose handling and complete partial-K coverage.

entries.title: TSQR panel reduction schedule
entries.candidate: Alternative panel row grouping using existing supported kernels
entries.hypothesis: Reduce launch or reduction latency with unchanged rank and iteration policy
entries.quality_gates: Orthogonality, reconstruction, residual, rank-deficient and tall/skinny cases
entries.actual_implementation: Use 128-row reflector-product partials instead of 256-row partials; preserve the scaled norm reduction, signs, complete reflector sequence and existing finish/update kernels.

entries.title: NMF update memory traffic
entries.candidate: Fuse elementwise multiply/divide and nonnegative write where outputs permit
entries.hypothesis: Remove a materialized intermediate without changing solver objective
entries.quality_gates: Reconstruction objective, nonnegative factors, zero denominators and heldout transform
entries.actual_implementation: Specialize OP_MUZ dispatch and process four independent coalesced output stripes per thread using the existing ew_cell(OP_MUZ) arithmetic and broadcast indices.

entries.title: Gaussian-process prediction batching
entries.candidate: Alternative bounded query batch or row tile
entries.hypothesis: Amortize launch and kernel reads while bounding workspace
entries.quality_gates: Predictive mean, nonnegative variance, uncertainty calibration, logloss and ill-conditioning
entries.actual_implementation: Use 128-query variance threadgroups in place of the default 256, preserving the complete ascending training-axis sum per query and all variance/std/clamp/probability work.

entries.title: Random-feature and kernel output work
entries.candidate: Coalesced or fused projection epilogue with unchanged random draws
entries.hypothesis: Save row traffic in reusable classical feature maps
entries.quality_gates: Feature-map quality, downstream task quality, seed behavior and kernel/solve residual
entries.actual_implementation: Each thread applies the same random offset to one component in four consecutive rows; keep the same add/cos/multiply sequence, random draws and projected values.

entries.title: Exact nearest-neighbor distance geometry
entries.candidate: Alternative hardware-sized query/index tile
entries.hypothesis: Change operand reuse and partial-distance pressure without reducing the index
entries.quality_gates: Tie-aware exact recall, no duplicate IDs, vote/regression quality and distance error
entries.actual_implementation: MQ_SG changes 8 to 4; complete 32-lane groups halve per-block query ownership while retaining matrix tile, all index slices and top-k state. Launch and query-grid geometry share MQ_TPB/MQ_SG.

entries.title: Streaming top-k merge granularity
entries.candidate: Bounded alternative candidate merge grouping
entries.hypothesis: Trade scratch writes for merge work without dropping candidates
entries.quality_gates: Exhaustive candidate coverage, ties, k tails, k greater than tile and duplicate points
entries.actual_implementation: FKT_T changes 64 to 128 candidate rows per shared tile, amortizing staging barriers at a 16 KiB feature tile plus norms for the widest existing admitted row. Every candidate is still inserted into the per-slice top-k and all slices merge.

entries.title: DBSCAN epsilon-neighborhood schedule
entries.candidate: Alternative row tile for complete epsilon neighborhoods
entries.hypothesis: Reuse distance operands while retaining every edge that passes epsilon
entries.quality_gates: Cluster-pair agreement, noise/core membership, epsilon boundary and dense components
entries.actual_implementation: ME_SG changes 8 to 4 complete SIMD groups per threadgroup, halving query ownership and exposing more blocks. Staged index tile, candidate coverage and exact epsilon-boundary fallback remain.

entries.title: HDBSCAN core-distance schedule
entries.candidate: Alternative bounded core-distance work grouping
entries.hypothesis: Increase occupancy without pruning neighbors or altering min_samples
entries.quality_gates: Cluster quality, noise, membership probabilities, MST/linkage validity and ties
entries.actual_implementation: CT_TILE changes 64 to 32 reference rows per shared tile, reducing its widest threadgroup storage from 16 KiB to 8 KiB while visiting every reference and retaining the same register top-k.

entries.title: KMeans assignment work grouping
entries.candidate: Alternative query/centroid tiling of exhaustive assignment
entries.hypothesis: Improve centroid reuse without changing starts or distance semantics
entries.quality_gates: Full-data inertia, heldout assignment, empty clusters and unchanged training budget
entries.actual_implementation: FUSED_NORMAL_TR changes 16 to 8 and FUSED_SKINNY_TR changes 8 to 4. Existing policy launch constants and footprint computations use the new row count; centroid column threads, feature tiles, alignment selection and exhaustive traversal stay fixed.

entries.title: KMeans center partial chunks
entries.candidate: Alternative row chunks for center accumulation
entries.hypothesis: Balance occupancy, contention and scratch fold work
entries.quality_gates: Inertia, finite centers, counts, weighted rows and high cluster imbalance
entries.actual_implementation: BLOCK_ACC_ROWS selects 128 with the new control; A retains the existing setting (256 with the listed overrides absent). This increases independent per-feature accumulation work and partial-table size while retaining Int32 sums and scale policy.

entries.title: MiniBatchKMeans resident schedule
entries.candidate: Alternative block/chunk grouping preserving every batch and stopping observation
entries.hypothesis: Reduce idle lanes and launch work without reducing iterations or samples
entries.quality_gates: Inertia, labels, counts, reassignment, stopping point semantics and fixed random draws
entries.actual_implementation: MBF_TPB changes 256 to 128 and MBF_CH follows it. Four SIMD groups per block reduce resource footprint and increase independent groups; equality of chunk and block width preserves the existing compacted sum one-thread-per-row contract.

entries.title: GMM expectation row scheduling
entries.candidate: Alternative bounded row/component tile
entries.hypothesis: Reuse component parameters while retaining stable logsumexp
entries.quality_gates: Heldout likelihood, responsibilities, covariance positivity and converged status
entries.actual_implementation: FE_TPB changes 256 to 128 on the fused path; GMM_ROW_TPB changes 128 to 64 for ordinary row kernels. Per-row component/feature traversal, stable logsumexp, refusal behavior and likelihood reduction policy remain.

entries.title: IVF query work partition
entries.candidate: Alternative bounded list/query task chunk
entries.hypothesis: Balance skewed inverted lists without changing nprobe or candidate set
entries.quality_gates: Recall at fixed probes, filters, no duplicate IDs, exhaustive-probe control and index identity
entries.actual_implementation: FIVF_QPB changes 4 to 2 SIMD-owned queries per block. Narrow/wide shared query tiles shrink from 4/32 KiB to 2/16 KiB; the feature cap explicitly stays at its baseline 2048 instead of expanding with the smaller block.

entries.title: UMAP optimizer edge grouping
entries.candidate: Alternative edge block size or reuse within existing seeded schedule
entries.hypothesis: Change occupancy without skipping edges or negative samples
entries.quality_gates: Trustworthiness, downstream task quality, fixed epochs/seed/negative-sample count
entries.actual_implementation: FAST_OPT_TPB changes 128 to 64 head rows per block. Each head still owns all its ordered edges, unchanged epoch snapshot and counter-derived negatives; dense and sparse FAST launchers import the same width.

entries.title: Spectral and LLE local product schedule
entries.estimators: SpectralEmbedding, SpectralClustering, LLE and related manifold callers
entries.candidate: Alternative bounded row or eigensolver work grouping
entries.hypothesis: Reduce serial work while preserving graph and solver convergence settings
entries.quality_gates: Embedding neighborhood quality, eigensystem residual, clustering quality and disconnected graphs
entries.actual_implementation: FL_SPMV_ROWS_PER_TG changes 8 to 4 complete SIMD-owned CSR rows. Existing 32-lane partition and row fold stay fixed, while shorter block lifetime can reduce scheduling effects of degree skew.

entries.title: MeanShift neighborhood row grouping
entries.candidate: Alternative complete pairwise neighborhood tile
entries.hypothesis: Improve load reuse without bandwidth approximation or seed subsampling
entries.quality_gates: Cluster centers, cluster-pair agreement, bandwidth boundaries and convergence status
entries.actual_implementation: MSG_T changes 256 to 512 while MSG_TPB stays 256. Two strided input-row passes amortize center staging and halve partial-table/final-fold work; the existing loop visits every row and handles ragged tails.

entries.title: Boosting histogram row chunks
entries.candidate: Alternative bounded row chunk
entries.hypothesis: Balance histogram scratch traffic and available independent groups
entries.quality_gates: Heldout RMSE/logloss/ranking quality, identical hyperparameters and all rows consumed
entries.actual_implementation: QH_MIN_ITEMS_PER_BLOCK is 4096 with T01 instead of 8192. The same constant feeds host replica selection and per-partition active-block limits; all rows keep their existing quantization and bin destinations.

entries.title: Boosting histogram feature grouping
entries.candidate: Alternative contiguous feature group
entries.hypothesis: Reuse row/bin loads without changing bins or selected features
entries.quality_gates: Quality across numerical/categorical columns, missing values and multiclass objectives
entries.actual_implementation: QH_GROUP_FEATURES becomes eight; shared allocation, whole compressed-index-word count, feature offsets, skip-bin vector width and launcher group count derive from it. This reduces the per-group histogram to 16 KiB.

entries.title: Binarization launch geometry
entries.candidate: Alternative coalesced row/feature launch
entries.hypothesis: Reduce launch overhead and improve sequential input reads
entries.quality_gates: Bin boundary semantics, NaNs, categorical codes and final fitted task quality
entries.actual_implementation: BINARIZE_BLOCK_SIZE becomes 512 instead of 1024, keeping eight documents per thread. Imported launcher constants and in-kernel row strides use the same geometry; all 256 border slots remain loadable.

entries.title: Tree row-partition schedule
entries.candidate: Alternative bounded partition block
entries.hypothesis: Reduce scattered read/write overhead while preserving membership
entries.quality_gates: Every row exactly once per partition, missing routing, child counts and task quality
entries.actual_implementation: SPLIT_BLOCK_SIZE becomes 128 instead of 256. Bin-update, partition-offset/size and associated fused winner/bin launches inherit the four-SIMD-group width and matching grids/shared-array sizing.

entries.title: Split-score reduction schedule
entries.candidate: Alternative cooperative or grouped score reduction
entries.hypothesis: Expose more independent score work without reducing candidates
entries.quality_gates: Best-score/tie semantics, constrained splits, monotonic settings and final quality
entries.actual_implementation: Inside existing cooperative _fold_block, a lane folds four adjacent candidate records before stepping by block_width*4, instead of one strided record. The same _record_less comparator, all candidates, shared winner reduction and descriptor writes remain.

entries.title: Leaf estimation partial chunks
entries.candidate: Alternative bounded row/leaf grouping
entries.hypothesis: Reduce contention and long partial sums at fixed leaf solver settings
entries.quality_gates: Leaf objectives, sample weights, small Hessians, ranking groups and heldout quality
entries.actual_implementation: _afcl_leaf_stats_sm maps the hardware-derived statistic scheduling budget to ceil(sm/2). Both scratch sizing and all one-/two-stat gathered/non-gathered leaf-statistic launches use the same budget; remaining solver/work kernels use the original sm.

entries.title: Boosted-tree prediction grouping
entries.candidate: Alternative rows or trees per block with same tree order
entries.hypothesis: Improve model reuse and output traffic
entries.quality_gates: Prediction error, accuracy/logloss, categorical CTR routing and repeated-call lifetime
entries.actual_implementation: Resident oblivious model application uses AFCL_PREDICT_BLOCK=128 instead of 256 for both ceil-divided row grids and launches, including ordinary per-tree/four-tree and packed all-tree applications. Existing bounded grid stride covers every row.

entries.title: RandomForest traversal geometry
entries.candidate: Alternative contiguous query grouping
entries.hypothesis: Reuse node cache lines without pruning trees
entries.quality_gates: Heldout quality, probabilities, uneven depth, multioutput and OOB behavior
entries.actual_implementation: RF_INPUT specializations use 64 instead of 128 threads per traversal group. Ordered and row-owned groves use matching ceil-divided grids; lane-owned groves use two rather than four rows, with matching shared row staging and partial-buffer layouts. Logical 32-tree grove reductions are retained.

entries.title: ExtraTrees training work grouping
entries.candidate: Alternative bounded row or feature grouping
entries.hypothesis: Improve parallelism without changing sampled thresholds or feature sets
entries.quality_gates: Fixed RNG mapping, impurity behavior, task quality and completed tree count
entries.actual_implementation: ET_FEATURE_TILE is eight instead of sixteen for tiled range searches and tiled regression-score kernels, including their ceil-divided feature grids. Selected feature slots and RNG/threshold assignment do not change.

entries.title: IsolationForest score grouping
entries.candidate: Alternative bounded query grouping
entries.hypothesis: Amortize node traffic with unchanged tree ensemble and correction
entries.quality_gates: Anomaly ranking, path lengths, contamination decisions and degenerate leaves
entries.actual_implementation: IF_PATH_TPB defaults to 128 instead of 256; IFLaunchKnobs.default and existing path/score launchers consume it, preserving per-row traversal and correction arithmetic.

entries.title: TreeSHAP query scheduling
entries.candidate: Alternative adjacent-row or block grouping
entries.hypothesis: Reuse model data while computing all contributions
entries.quality_gates: Additivity, reference contributions, interactions when supported and memory lifetime
entries.actual_implementation: QUERY_TPB=64 instead of 128 is used by query grids for direct tree units, table row units, decision-word table row units and final contribution fold. Preparation and table construction retain TPB=128.

entries.title: Categorical CTR preprocessing schedule
entries.candidate: Alternative bounded row/category chunks
entries.hypothesis: Improve occupancy without changing category ordering or smoothing
entries.quality_gates: Leakage prevention, unseen categories, ordered statistics, ranking groups and final quality
entries.actual_implementation: CTR_BLOCK_SIZE=128 instead of 256 changes the existing elementwise/calculation launchers and their matching per-thread row strides. CTR_DOCS_PER_THREAD stays four.

entries.title: Scaler reduction independent accumulators
entries.baseline: One running accumulation chain per lane
entries.candidate: Two independent accumulators over the same observations
entries.hypothesis: Hide load/add dependency latency without approximating statistics
entries.quality_gates: Large offsets, NaNs, zero variance, transformed outputs and downstream model quality
entries.actual_implementation: Two independent per-lane FP32 sums in the two-pass col_stats path; two independent Welford chains followed by existing Chan merge in the current SI_ONEPASS/fused-transform cs_tile path.

entries.title: MaxAbs row tiling
entries.candidate: Half-sized row tiles with unchanged feature grouping
entries.hypothesis: Expose more work on narrow inputs at the cost of partial-fold traffic
entries.quality_gates: Exact finite maxima, NaN/zero handling and transformed output
entries.actual_implementation: MaxAbs direct-fit row chunks 1024/128 become 512/64; feature-width policy is untouched.

entries.title: Categorical Naive Bayes count grouping
entries.candidate: Alternative threads per block
entries.hypothesis: Change occupancy and atomic contention without changing integer counts
entries.quality_gates: Class/feature counts, smoothing, unseen categories and heldout logloss
entries.actual_implementation: Categorical count launch uses 64 threads instead of 128; final integer-count conversion launch is unchanged.

entries.title: Sparse Naive Bayes row grouping
entries.estimators: MultinomialNB, BernoulliNB and ComplementNB where admitted
entries.candidate: Half-sized CSR row group
entries.hypothesis: Bound row-search and shared-metadata pressure on skewed sparse rows
entries.quality_gates: Counts, class priors, negative-input refusal, posterior quality and empty rows
entries.actual_implementation: CSR histogram groups contain 32 rows instead of 64; the 256-thread block and all nonzero processing remain.

entries.title: Target-encoding work grouping
entries.candidate: Alternative cooperative group size for existing sums
entries.hypothesis: Reduce long row reductions while preserving cross-fitting and leakage rules
entries.quality_gates: Fold isolation, category smoothing, unseen-category behavior and downstream task quality
entries.actual_implementation: TargetEncoder global/category folds use independent TE_TGR=128 rather than shared TGR=256, including scratch, strides, tree fold and launch size.

entries.title: Iterative-imputer convergence fold
entries.candidate: Alternative convergence reduction work grouping
entries.hypothesis: Reduce reduction latency without changing tolerance or observation frequency
entries.quality_gates: Imputed values, observed entries unchanged, stopping semantics and downstream quality
entries.actual_implementation: Existing imputer row-max convergence reduction uses 512 rather than 256 lanes, with matching shared array, stride and launch.

entries.title: Feature-selection row tile
entries.candidate: Half as many observations per lane
entries.hypothesis: Trade increased grid parallelism against partial scratch/fold cost
entries.quality_gates: Scores, p-values, selected features, class imbalance and force_finite behavior
entries.actual_implementation: Feature statistic row tiles use RPT=32 rather than 64, RT=256 rather than 512, retaining the 32-column by 8-row-lane block.

entries.title: Regression metric independent accumulators
entries.candidate: Independent accumulators or grouped partial work over same rows
entries.hypothesis: Shorten dependency chains in metric reduction
entries.quality_gates: Independent FP64 metric agreement, sample weights, multioutput and finite policy
entries.actual_implementation: Two independent software-binary64 accumulation chains in uniform and weighted multioutput regression score averaging.

entries.title: Ranking metric prefix work grouping
entries.candidate: Alternative bounded work grouping with stable equal-score groups
entries.hypothesis: Improve occupancy without dropping thresholds or changing ties
entries.quality_gates: Exact threshold membership, tie groups, weighted areas and degenerate labels
entries.actual_implementation: Weighted/unweighted curve-prefix chunk size 1024 becomes 512 in the planner and emitted stage parameters.

entries.title: Resampling gather tile geometry
entries.candidate: Alternative fixed hardware-sized tile
entries.hypothesis: Coalesce wide rows and improve narrow-row occupancy; same drawn indices
entries.quality_gates: Exact paired-array row draws, old-output lifetime and statistical interval/p-value quality
entries.actual_implementation: Grouped resample gather tile 32 features by 8 rows becomes 16 features by 16 rows, retaining 256 threads.

entries.title: Stationarity series reduction schedule
entries.candidate: Alternative supported per-series group width
entries.hypothesis: Reduce serial per-series work without changing tested orders or significance
entries.quality_gates: KPSS statistics, differencing decisions, finite-input refusals and forecast quality
entries.actual_implementation: Two independent per-thread chains for series sums/squared sums followed by the existing STATS_TPB block reduction.

entries.title: Batched ARIMA likelihood work grouping
entries.candidate: Alternative series-per-block or block width using existing recurrence
entries.hypothesis: Increase independent-series occupancy while preserving full recurrence and optimizer settings
entries.quality_gates: Likelihood/gradient quality, selected orders, optimizer status and heldout forecast error
entries.actual_implementation: Kalman series block default 32 becomes 64; propagated through public likelihood/forecast helpers, packed likelihood, optimizer and retained-evaluation workspace entrances.

entries.title: KDE stable score work grouping
entries.candidate: Alternative bounded query grouping preserving stable logsumexp
entries.hypothesis: Reuse training data while keeping every density contribution
entries.quality_gates: Independent density/log-likelihood error, extreme bandwidths, far queries and heldout likelihood
entries.actual_implementation: KDE2_QM changes 4 to 2 queries per thread. The query tile changes 64 to 32 rows; per-thread distance accumulators and shared query/reduction pages shrink. The existing query-grid-based chunk planner follows the new tile, retains every train contribution and uses the same stable max-rescaled logsumexp.

entries.title: Agglomerative graph/MST work grouping
entries.candidate: Alternative bounded complete edge work grouping
entries.hypothesis: Balance independent distance or Boruvka work without dropping edges
entries.quality_gates: Linkage validity, cluster-pair quality, ties, disconnected graphs and supported linkage semantics
entries.actual_implementation: MB_T changes 128 to 64 reference rows per shared/prefetched tile, retaining complete 32-row MMA admission groups. Operand/metadata shared pages and prefetch registers halve; full candidate traversal, scalar exact recomputation, lower-bound filter and value/index tie ordering remain.

entries.title: Robust covariance C-step scheduling
entries.candidate: Alternative row or independent-trial schedule
entries.hypothesis: Reuse covariance factors and balance active trials without reducing starts or C steps
entries.quality_gates: Robust covariance/support/location, contamination behavior, anomaly ranking and singular cases
entries.actual_implementation: Select each C-step trial's support with 128 threads rather than 256; all eight radix passes and the ascending-index tie scan remain. Initial and iterative support selection use the same geometry.

entries.title: SGD linear update work grouping
entries.estimators: SGDClassifier, SGDRegressor and applicable linear SGD callers
entries.candidate: Alternative feature or row grouping preserving exact training examples and epoch order
entries.hypothesis: Improve occupancy or load reuse without reducing epochs or changing learning-rate policy
entries.quality_gates: Heldout loss/accuracy/RMSE, seeded shuffle semantics, weights, sparse inputs and convergence
entries.actual_implementation: Schedule independent minibatch prediction/loss rows in 128-thread blocks instead of 256-thread blocks; witness capacity, offsets and launch count use the same new row-grid helper.

entries.title: Gaussian Naive Bayes class-statistic chains
entries.candidate: Independent class-filtered accumulation chains
entries.hypothesis: Shorten dependent sums while retaining every class observation and centered variance
entries.quality_gates: Class counts/means/variances, variance smoothing, rare classes and heldout logloss
entries.actual_implementation: Two independent per-lane chains for unweighted class-filtered sums and centered squared deviations; existing count and reduction tree remain.

entries.title: Holt-Winters series launch geometry
entries.estimators: HoltWinters and applicable ETS forecasting callers
entries.candidate: Alternative independent-series block width
entries.hypothesis: Amortize scheduling without modifying serial recurrence, season length or optimizer work
entries.quality_gates: Heldout forecast error, smoothing parameters, initial states, seasonal tails and refusal handling
entries.actual_implementation: Default optimizer group width HW_OPTIM_TPB changes 128 to 64; existing callers continue using the shared default.
